resources.string: Where the full-colour weather artwork plays. Turn a surface off to show its still artwork instead — the forecast strips are the ones that cost the most, since they animate a dozen icons side by side.
These apply to this device everywhere weather is shown, not just to this pill. The same switches are in Settings › Appearance › Icons.
